name: Wonderful Ape 22
author: Kenny10000
description: Neon cyan button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks:
On hover, background changes from #000 to #0ea5e9, box-shadow becomes 0 0 5px #0ea5e9, 0 0 25px #0ea5e9, 0 0 50px #0ea5e9,
    0 0 100px #0ea5e9, text color changes from #fff to #fff.
